description: Looks up one company's open roles on Applystead, for questions like “is Stripe hiring?” or “what jobs does Acme have open?”. company is a company name or Applystead company slug. Returns the company's name, its number of open roles and its company page, with its 10 newest open jobs, each linking its Applystead job page and an Apply with Applystead link. Apply with Applystead opens an Applystead account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person.

company.description: Company name or Applystead company slug.

name: get_company_jobs
title: Get a company's jobs
